About

I'm Mattia Giannattasio, a filmmaker, designer and photographer based in Parma, Italy.

I make short films and visual campaigns for technology brands and cultural institutions.

Explore my work →

The practice

Filmmaking, design and photography meet in the visual direction of my projects: the references, compositions and rhythm that bring an idea into focus. You can see that approach in the storyboard and direction for Roncato and the visuals around Noah Baine’s music releases.

Alongside commissioned work, I make independent films and photographic projects, and write The Creative Lens, a newsletter on technology, design and storytelling.

Working together

I work with brands, cultural institutions and creative teams on films and visual campaigns. You can bring me into the conversation while the idea is still taking shape.

Tell me what you’re making, where it will live and when you need it.
